svg.title: Azure SRE Agent / workshop logical architecture
svg.desc: Workshop logical architecture, not Azure backend internals. Human chat starts with the main agent; explicit custom-agent invocation or an accepted incident response plan selects lab-triage. Intended AKS delegation returns evidence to triage before analyst synthesis. Skills and knowledge retrieval are separate. Approved read tools require execution identity, effective RBAC, connector authorization and network reachability. Incident plans remain Off in Review until acceptance; optional scheduled tasks are separate. All runtime paths need independent Lab 5 proof.

g.text: Azure SRE Agent / workshop logical architecture
Configured intent, not runtime proof or a diagram of Azure backend internals
